mission_phase: Generation 19 - Operational Controls: Run Queue and Data Management
phase_goal: Give the operator operational control: (1) a persistent single-at-a-time inspection run queue with transparency and management, and (2) a discoverable data-management settings area with cleanup including screenshot/capture reclamation.
reason_generation_started: Operator observed that Add Site & Inspect, Rerun, Resume, and Run Verification each spawn independent child processes with no concurrency control, risking rate-limits (the 429s we have been fighting) and hiding what is in flight. Requested a single-at-a-time queue with transparency and basic management, persisted across restarts.

functional: N enqueued runs execute strictly one at a time (no two run-inspection children concurrently).
Queue state persists to disk and is reloaded on dashboard restart; a run interrupted by a restart is reconciled (not left as 'running').
Cancel removes a pending item, and stops a running item; clear empties pending; the running item is never silently dropped.
Every run-spawning dashboard action enqueues instead of spawning directly.
Cleanup offers a captures-only policy that removes screenshots/raw from runs while keeping structured evidence and reports; preview shows bytes freed.
usability: The dashboard shows the running item and the ordered pending list with enqueue reasons/labels, plus cancel/clear controls.
Live browser walkthrough: enqueue several runs, observe one running and the rest pending, cancel one, confirm order.
Data-management/cleanup is reachable from a discoverable Settings location, not buried below the run list.
technical: npm run validate:dashboard extended with queue API assertions (enqueue, list, single-runner, cancel, persistence reconcile).
npm run validate, validate:gen13 remain green; git diff --check clean.

validation_notes: VAL-067 first clean pass: queue single-runner, persistence/reconcile, cancel/clear, captures-only cleanup, and the site-profile cache-schema fix all validated; suites green.
VAL-067 second independent pass: no implementation changes since the commit; suites green and the single-runner behavior reproduced (1 running child, N pending).
BDD inventory refreshed to BDD-INV-008 (50 BDDs, 5 new for GEN-019, 48 passing, 2 deferred).
known_gaps_opened: Queue reordering of pending items is not exposed yet (cancel/clear only).
A run orphaned by a restart is reconciled as interrupted but its orphaned child process is not force-killed.
Captures-only cleanup removes screenshots/raw for all runs at once; per-run capture cleanup is not offered.
scope_addendum: Expanded 2026-07-15 to also resolve FND-GEN019-002 (data-management discoverability + capture cleanup) alongside the chartered queue (FND-GEN019-003).
